name: Cubic Shading
definition: An extension of grey-level gradient shading that uses all 26 neighbors of a center voxel in a 3x3x3 window (cubic window) to calculate the gradient, rather than just the 6 immediate orthogonal neighbors.
summary: Cubic shading estimates surface normals using all 26 neighbors in a 3x3x3 window, producing smoother images than standard methods that use only six orthogonal neighbors.
